designationHistory.indexText: Congress established Bogue Chitto National Wildlife Refuge.

Public Law 96-288, June 28, 1980, 94 Stat. 603 (govinfo): "To establish the Bogue Chitto National Wildlife Refuge"
USFWS, 508 Bogue Chitto National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 168185): lands approved under 94 Stat. 604, dated June 28, 1980

review.note: P.L. 96-288, June 28, 1980 (Carter). The CCP elsewhere says signed June 30; the statute is dated June 28.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Bogue Chitto National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1980, straddles the borders of Louisiana and Mississippi, bisected by the Pearl River.
